program.name: Twenty Ladder
program.subject: Busy week
program.blurb: Rep ladders against the clock: 1 rep of each move, then 2, then 3… climb as high as you can before time runs out.
program.about: Rep ladders against the clock: one rep of each move, then two, then three, as high as you can climb. Two ladders a day, pairing push and squat or pull and lunge. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations. Short, competitive sessions that track your progress by where you reach.
